description: Input description for a CO2 capture model in BattMo

permeances.description: permeance values. One value for each specie. The order is given by the gasSpecies property. The unit is mol/(m*s*Pa)

Geometry.description: geometry data for the CO2 capture device. For the moment only 1D support

length.description: length of the device. The unit is meter

areas.description: cross section areas for the feed and permeate channels. The unit is m^2
